correctness.rationale: The pure prime-qudit graph-state phase across a cut is omega^(x^T Gamma y); tracing B produces kernel coset blocks and exactly p^R equal eigenvalues p^-R where R=rank_Fp Gamma. For diagonal rectangle blocks A, all crossing adjacency outputs depend solely on row/column margins, whose only two compatibility constraints leave m+n-2 dimensions. Kernel of the margin-to-output map has constants alpha,beta obeying [[a,c],[d,b]](alpha,beta)=0, dimension 2-r_p. Therefore rank Gamma=m+n-4+r_p and all Rényi spectra follow. Direct independent finite-field Gaussian elimination of the literal rook cross-cut matrices confirmed formula for 243 cases a,b,c,d=1..3, p=2,3,5. All prime p and positive block sizes covered algebraically; arbitrary cuts not claimed.
